title: The extension represents the genuine half-Rayleigh gradient
source_anchor: Boumal, §5.5, Example 5.17, induced gradient; Example 3.62, unhalved antecedent; printed p. 96 / PDF p. 112
target_statement: For a symmetric linear operator on a real Euclidean space, the half-normalized quadratic restricted to the unit sphere is differentiable. Its induced gradient at a unit point x is the tangent vector Ax − ⟨x,Ax⟩x, representing the actual restricted differential with the ambient inner product and the differential of inclusion.
